name: Capoliveri (Italy)
description: Blue field bearing a red panel charged with a white lozenge and a green rectangle with a yellow anchor, with three yellow bees at the upper fly of the panel.
history: Municipal flag of Capoliveri, a comune in Tuscany; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: rectangle at the centre of the lozenge
anchor on the green rectangle and three bees at the upper fly
